_readme: Settings for the Magic basket game (Level 2, the village apple tree). Change numbers here; no code change needed. catchesToWin: right apples needed to finish (at least one of each of the letter's sounds; raised to the number of sounds if that is bigger). targetChance: 0..1, how often a new apple carries one of the letter's sounds. maxApplesOnScreen: apples falling at once. dropEverySeconds: time between two apples. fallSeconds: how long an apple takes from the tree to the ground (bigger = slower). Stars: a mistake is a wrong apple in the basket, or (if countMissedAsMistake) a right apple that hit the ground. 0..threeStarsMaxMistakes = 3 stars, up to twoStarsMaxMistakes = 2 stars, more = 1 star. background: the village picture (drawn in code when missing); backgroundMarks.feetY: where the brothers' feet go in it, as a fraction of its height. Sounds per letter live in letters.json. Pictures (made by tools/games/process_magic_basket.py; when a file is missing that part is drawn in code): treeImage, appleImage, basketImage. appleLetterSpot: where the sound goes on the apple (center x/y and size, fractions of the picture; the script prints it). basketOpening: the line across the middle of the basket's opening, as a fraction of its height (the script prints it); apples sit on it and the part below is drawn over them. treeMarks (fractions of the tree picture, as drawn in English; Arabic mirrors it): seatX/seatY = where the brother sits on the branch, rootY = the roots' line that stands on the path, dropY = where apples come out of the leaves.
